name: 01469 · Townsend, MA
findings: ZIP 01469 (Townsend) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01469 (Townsend) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01469 (Townsend) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
